source.scope: Unmodified official GraphCast inference import closure and upstream license

input_policy: Deterministic synthetic inputs; actual model shapes and frequencies. Not captured activations.
timing_scope: HIP event averages over repeated operations, 5 warmups, allocations and correctness excluded. No interposer/routing overhead. Synthetic inputs at real model shapes; not end-to-end performance.

graph_operators.input_policy: Official graph indices; seeded JAX normal FP32 features, affine LayerNorm parameters synthesized. Batch=1 is flattened.
graph_operators.timing_scope: Synchronized JAX wall time; compile, input generation/transfer and validation excluded. Independent operations do not reproduce the model's fused kernels.
